FOOTNOTES

1/ General Appropriations Act funds are appropriated as a Lump Sum by Agency.

Operating Budget

The Baseline includes \$1,074,300 and 13 FTE Positions from the General Fund in FY 2027 for the operating budget. These amounts are unchanged from FY 2026.

Territorial Governor's Mansion Restoration

The Baseline includes no funding in FY 2027 for the Territorial Governor's Mansion Restoration line item. Adjustments are as follows:

Remove One-Time Restoration Funding The Baseline includes a decrease of \$(500,000) from General Fund in FY 2027 to remove a one-time appropriation for Territorial Governor's Mansion restoration efforts. Per a FY 2026 budget footnote, these monies are non-lapsing.

The Territorial Governor's Mansion is a log cabin built in 1864. The state purchased the building in 1917 and the building has been used as part of the Sharlot Hall Museum since 1928. Restoration entails replacing deteriorating chinking and daubing. These are the materials that constitute the fill between logs.
